answer: tundra nadir plume. Proof of tenure: bidding needs thirty epoch challenges signed in one unbroken chain. First, it registers one key and signs every challenge on time. Second, the ledger checks the chain; one missed or wrong signature resets the count to zero. Third, a sybil with one hundred identities must keep every chain alive for thirty epochs, seven days running, before any can bid: three thousand flawless answers; one slip wipes a chain out. Like a tundra trek, only the crew at every camp reaches the summit; a plume of fresh tracks at the nadir proves nothing without the trail.
